notes.title: 🌊 Behind-the-Scenes of 『NOAH: 2050』
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team NOAH.

Are you enjoying the game? This is a notice about the behind-the-scenes of the game's development that we couldn't share on the store page.

Since the game's release, we have been uploading behind-the-scenes content of 『NOAH: 2050』 on Team NOAH's blog. As of today, a total of 14 behind-the-scenes stories have been revealed.

New behind-the-scenes content is uploaded every Thursday at 3 PM, and we will notify you through social media, so please follow us on X and Instagram.

We hope you enjoy the behind-the-scenes stories as well. If you have any questions or want to know more about a specific behind-the-scenes story, please let us know in the comments.

Team NOAH's Blog: https://noah-2050.tistory.com/

We wish you a great day.

Best regards,
Team NOAH.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, this is Team NOAH.
We would like to briefly inform you about the v1.0.2 patch contents.

[Patch Notes]
- Typos and errors within the scenario have been corrected.
- An issue where missions were not completing despite meeting the completion conditions has been fixed.

We continue to receive bug reports and other suggestions on Team NOAH's Discord server.

Best regards,
Team NOAH.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, I'm Team NOAH.
I'm sorry that gameplay wasn't possible.

This is a guide to the v1.0.1 patch.

[Modified content]
- It has been modified so that you can quickly turn over the chat room even if you hold the mouse button.
- The point that the conversation history window could remain open at the end of the scenario has been corrected.
- Some pop-up images of the Navigation-Likes item have been replaced.
- Two new quests have been added. (#038, #041)
- We have corrected the point that the likability could change abnormally when fetching.
- I modified the part where the scrolling in the cell phone chat room was not smooth.
- Fixed a phenomenon that might not have been able to click on a choice at once under certain conditions.
- I corrected the phenomenon that the quest was completed even when SOL-A capsule intake failed.
- Fix other bugs and improve performance

Team NOAH.
